Ngokungagqibekanga i-ejenti ithumela i-telemetry yokhuseleko nee-hash zeefayile: amagama eenkqubo nemigca yemiyalelo, iindlela zeefayile, imethadatha yoqhagamshelo lwenethiwekhi, nokufunyenweyo. Umxholo weefayile uqokelelwa kuphela ukuba umbutho wakho ukuvulile oko.

Ngexesha lolingo lwasimahla, nakwizicwangciso ezingahlawulelwanga, ikhonsoli ibonisa iintengiso ze-Google AdSense kwaye ii-app zeselula zibonisa iintengiso ze-Google AdMob, emva kokucela imvume yakho. Ababhalisileyo babona iintengiso ezingama-95% ezimbalwa. Iintengiso azize zivele kwizikrini zemvume, zolawulo, zezilumkiso zesigrogriso, zohlolo lokuvalelwa, zokungena, zentlawulo okanye zophicotho.
Ukupapasha ngakunye kwenza inguqulelo entsha etyikityiweyo. Izixhobo ziqhubeka nokunyanzelisa inguqulelo yokugqibela eqinisekisiweyo xa zingaxhumananga.
I-Equality Software Ltd iqhuba i-Agentic Antivirus. Eli phepha lichaza oko kuqokelelwa yinkonzo. Kufuneka lihlolwe ngumnini wemveliso phambi kokupapashwa.

Lonke inyathelo elitshintsha isixhobo, iakhawunti okanye itrafikhi lidlula kwinjini yomgaqo-nkqubo nolawulo lwe-AEP-X. Imvume igubungela inyathelo elinye, iithagethi zalo ngqo, lo mbutho, nexesha elimiselweyo.
Konke okulayishwayo kujongwa i-malware nohlobo lwako lokwenyani. Iifayile ezingenasijongi esiqinisekisiweyo ziyagcinwa kwaye ziyakhutshelwa kodwa azijongwa kwangaphambili.
